subtitle.zh: 来源：ickb/contracts / scripts/contracts/ickb_logic/src　·　mainnet code_hash 0x2a81…3bd3（data1，由 release 二进制计算并在链上确认）
subtitle.en: Source: ickb/contracts / scripts/contracts/ickb_logic/src　·　mainnet code_hash 0x2a81…3bd3 (data1, computed from the release binary and confirmed on-chain)

title.zh: CKB 存入 → 存款 + 回执

label.zh: DAO 存款（N 个，金额相同）

cond.zh: 每种金额：输出存款个数 = 回执 quantity 之和
cond.en: per amount: output deposit count = Σ receipt quantity

body.zh:
Cell{ type: ICKB_LOGIC, data: {quantity, amount} }
// header_deps: 回执所在块
body.en:
Cell{ type: ICKB_LOGIC, data: {quantity, amount} }
// header_deps: the receipt's block

outputs.label: iCKB xUDT

cond.zh: iCKB = amount × AR₀ / AR_m（AR₀ = 10¹⁶），超过 100,000 iCKB 的部分打 9 折
cond.en: iCKB = amount × AR₀ / AR_m (AR₀ = 10¹⁶), 10% off above 100,000 iCKB per deposit

cond.zh: Σ输入 UDT + Σ输入回执价值 = Σ输出 UDT + Σ输入存款价值
cond.en: Σ input UDT + Σ input receipt value = Σ output UDT + Σ input deposit value

cond.zh: 输出单个 UDT 数量 ≤ u64::MAX

inputs.label: iCKB xUDT
inputs.body: Cell{ type: iCKB xUDT, data: amount }

label.zh: DAO 取款请求（通常由 owned_owner 锁定）
label.en: DAO withdrawal request (usually locked by owned_owner)

outputs.body: Cell{ lock: OWNED_OWNER, type: NERVOS_DAO, data: {{block number}} }

cond.zh: 销毁的 iCKB = 存款按其区块 AR 计算的价值
cond.en: burned iCKB = deposit value at its block AR

notes.zh: 误用检查（6 ScriptMisuse，输入输出全部 cell）：DAO 存款或 iCKB xUDT 不能做 lock；ICKB_LOGIC lock 必须配 DAO 存款 type
notes.en: Misuse (6 ScriptMisuse, all cells): a DAO deposit or iCKB xUDT can never be a lock; an ICKB_LOGIC lock must carry a DAO deposit type

notes.zh: 错误码：1–4 系统 · 5 NotEmptyArgs · 6 ScriptMisuse · 7 DepositTooSmall · 8 DepositTooBig · 9 EmptyReceipt · 10 ReceiptMismatch · 11 AmountMismatch · 12 AmountUnreasonablyBig
notes.en: Error codes: 1–4 syscall · 5 NotEmptyArgs · 6 ScriptMisuse · 7 DepositTooSmall · 8 DepositTooBig · 9 EmptyReceipt · 10 ReceiptMismatch · 11 AmountMismatch · 12 AmountUnreasonablyBig

notes.zh: args 必须为空，且输出中不能出现同 code 但 args 非空的 lock（5）
notes.en: args must be empty, and no output lock with the same code but other args may exist (5)
